Every address a Chicago directory of 1839, 1843 or 1844 prints as a RESIDENCE — its own `res` or `bds` — against a person of 1835, put through the five clauses of docs/RESIDENCE-BACK-PROJECTION.md. The policy is L223 and the unit of a placement is a STREET FACE, never a corner, never a lot and never a roof. Refusals are here in full: an address this pass declines is a reading it made, not one it missed.
